meta.source: Income-tax Act 1961 and Income-tax Act 2025 cross-reference table

16(ia).title: Standard Deduction for Salaried Employees & Pensioners
16(ia).notes: Flat deduction from salary income; revised to ₹75,000 under New Regime from FY 2024-25 / FY 2025-26.

10(13A).title: House Rent Allowance (HRA) Exemption
10(13A).notes: Least of: actual HRA, rent paid minus 10% basic+DA, 50%/40% basic+DA. Old regime only.

24(b).title: Deduction for Home Loan Interest (Income from House Property)
24(b).notes: Capped at ₹2,00,000 for self-occupied property. Old regime only.

80C.title: Deduction for Life Insurance, PF, PPF, ELSS, Tuition, Home Loan Principal

80CCD(1B).title: Additional Deduction for National Pension System (NPS)
80CCD(1B).notes: Additional ₹50,000 for individual NPS voluntary contribution. Old regime only.

80CCD(2).title: Employer's Contribution to National Pension System (NPS)
80CCD(2).notes: Allowed in both Old and New regimes (up to 14% of salary for Govt and Private employers).

80D.title: Medical Insurance Premium and Preventive Health Check-up
80D.notes: Self/family ₹25,000 (₹50,000 senior); parents ₹25,000 (₹50,000 senior). Old regime only.

80E.title: Interest on Loan taken for Higher Education
80E.notes: No upper cap; available for up to 8 assessment years. Old regime only.

80G.title: Donations to Certain Funds, Charitable Institutions
80G.notes: 50% or 100% deduction subject to qualifying limits. Old regime only.

80TTA.title: Interest on Savings Accounts (Non-Senior Individuals)
80TTA.notes: Up to ₹10,000 for individuals aged under 60. Old regime only.

80TTB.title: Interest on Deposits in Bank/Post Office for Senior Citizens
80TTB.notes: Up to ₹50,000 for individuals aged 60 and above. Old regime only.

80DD.title: Maintenance and Medical Treatment of Disabled Dependent
80DD.notes: Verify against finalized 2025 rules; ₹75,000 standard disability, ₹1,25,000 severe disability. Old regime only.

80DDB.title: Medical Treatment of Specified Diseases
80DDB.notes: Verify against finalized 2025 rules; ₹40,000 (₹1,00,000 for senior). Old regime only.

80U.title: Deduction in Case of a Person with Disability
80U.notes: Verify against finalized 2025 rules; ₹75,000 standard, ₹1,25,000 severe. Old regime only.

87A.title: Rebate of Income-tax in Case of Certain Individuals
87A.notes: Up to ₹60,000 for income <= ₹12,00,000 in New Regime (FY 25-26 & FY 26-27), up to ₹12,500 in Old Regime for income <= ₹5,00,000.

115BAC.title: Default Concessional Tax Regime (New Regime)
115BAC.notes: Concessional slab rates with limited deductions. Default regime from AY 2024-25 onwards.

234A.title: Interest for Default in Furnishing Return of Income
234A.notes: 1% simple interest per month or part month on unpaid tax.

234B.title: Interest for Defaults in Payment of Advance Tax (<90% of assessed tax)
234B.notes: 1% simple interest per month from 1st April of assessment year to date of determination.

234C.title: Interest for Deferment of Advance Tax Installments
234C.notes: 1% per month for shortfall in 15%, 45%, 75%, 100% installments.
